Welcome to the blog! This is where I'll write about the things I'm working on and thinking about: programming, game design, gaming, retrocomputing, music, language and culture.

What to expect

  • Notes and behind-the-scenes bits from my projects
  • Code, with syntax highlighting
  • Music, including the occasional tracker module
  • Whatever else is on my mind
